QuestInfo.name: Safe and Secure
QuestInfo.0: Explain the situation to Lania and install the barrier.

0.0: What's going on? A weird robot and a stranger showed up at my place. The robot keeps hiccuping and the man tried to sell me some kind of weird bean sundae!\r\n#L0##bI sent them.#l\n#k
0.1: You did? How come?\r\n#L0##bI'm about to undertake a dangerous task. My enemies may go after my loved ones...after you. I must do everything in my power to keep you safe.#l\n#k
0.2: Well, okay. But you should have told me first!

no.0: Don't you dare ditch me again!
